extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.71[CR]- Preload fresh Amazon In Progress history and show an account-scoped memory preview while each menu visit refreshes in the background; do not save history snapshots to disk.[CR]- Invalidate In Progress observations around playback changes, reject older in-flight responses and warm fresh history after provider STOP settlement.[CR]- Start Movies and TV genre cards at the beginning when switching sections; preserve same-section return positions and keep native genre items separate.[CR]- Observe Kodi native fullscreen cleanup before fallback activation and acknowledge verified catalog bindings while focus settles after window initialization.[CR]- Preserve the working Watchlist, HD playback, eliminated startup flash, persistent pinned Chrome and all accumulated fixes.
